name: Noah Hägglund
headline: Sound Designer & Composer
description:
Stockholm-based sound designer and audio engineer working across film, games, animation and commercial productions.

Ps. I do video editing as well!
bio: My name is Noah Hägglund. I am a sound designer, composer and audio engineer based in Stockholm, originally from Hälsingland. I create sound and music for games, animation, film and pretty much anything that moves — or doesn’t.
Over the past several years, I have developed my craft through work on film and television projects, with a particular focus on short-form commercials and presentation films.
I also have experience working on longer-form productions, including drama and documentaries.
My approach is rooted in detail and intention, creating sound that adds weight, movement and character, while drawing attention to the right things in each project.
